verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair privacy question for a hosted plugin ecosystem spanning ChatGPT and Codex, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or storage location controls. The closest item, the Sign in with ChatGPT note on sharing name, email and picture with partners, covers data sharing, not where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
